name: Jacky Rosen
committees: Senate Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs
stance: A former computer programmer who, citing researchers' warnings of catastrophic AI risk, is demanding immediate Senate Commerce hearings with top AI executives and guardrails.

statements.text: Called on the Senate Commerce Committee chairman to immediately hold a hearing with the top executives of the leading American AI companies, following dire warnings from AI researchers.
At the same time, this powerful technology can have the power to cause catastrophic damages if we don't act to impose guardrails and safety mechanisms

review.note: added October 2026 from rosen.senate.gov primary sources; quote verified verbatim
